title: Quiz — Body Organization & Homeostasis
instructions: Multiple choice. Bubble your answer on the sheet. Every question comes from your notes.

items.question: Anatomy is the study of ____, while physiology is the study of ____.
Which lists the levels of organization from SMALLEST to LARGEST?
choices: cell → chemical → tissue → organ → organism → organ system
chemical → cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism
organism → organ system → organ → tissue → cell → chemical
cell → tissue → chemical → organ → organ system → organism

items.question: A group of SIMILAR cells working together on one job is a(n):
Why is the heart classified as an ORGAN?
choices: It is a single type of cell repeated many times
It is made of two or more tissues working together
It is the smallest unit of life
It is a group of organs sharing a function

items.question: Homeostasis is best defined as:
choices: the body growing larger over time
cells dividing to make new cells

items.question: In a negative feedback loop, the response always:
choices: creates a new stimulus that grows

items.question: You get too hot and start to sweat, cooling back down. Put the loop in order:
Which is an example of NEGATIVE feedback?
choices: Shivering to warm up when body temperature drops
Contractions getting stronger and stronger during childbirth
A cut triggering more and more clotting until sealed
A rumor spreading faster the more people hear it
